messages:
jamie: FYI, just pulled node g2-21 back into quarantine after it produced repeated soft XIDs during a 6h soak. Holding before we return to pool.

neha: Can you paste the kernel/Xid logs? wondering if it's ECC flips or PCIe resets.

jamie: pasted below — Xid 62 with a couple of preceding pcie error lines. repro happened ~5x over 6h, temps were normal.

jamie: ```
[ 2434.112345] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3a:00): 62, PID=0, GPU=0000:3a:00: A fault has occurred during a channel[]
[ 2434.112347] pciehp 0000:3a:00: PCIe link down
[ 2434.112350] pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Corrected error, upstream bridge returned status 0x00000001
```

ops-bot: started soak job j-2297 on g2-21 (profile: extended-temperature-cycles, duration: 24h) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: Suggested triage steps (quick):
1) run targeted memtest on GPU VRAM (gpuburn/memtest)
2) run continuous PCIe stress while collecting AER logs
3) try driver 535.x fallback if we suspect regression

sam: quick command I'm going to run if no objections:
```
sudo docker run --rm --gpus all redwood/gpuburn:latest sh -c \"gpuburn --time 3600 --mode memfill && stress-ng --gpu 2 --timeout 1800\"
```

maria: also worth a quick slot swap to a neighboring riser to rule out slot/PSU/power-headroom. If it follows the card -> hardware. If stays on slot -> riser/board.

lucas: Agree with slot swap. Also let's capture PCIe AER counters every 60s while soak runs:
```
watch -n 60 'dmesg | tail -n 50 | egrep "AER|Xid|pcie" >> /var/log/gpu-soak/g2-21-aer.log
```

neha: Putting a slightly different soak profile in ops: oscillate fan target between 40-80% every 30m to stress thermal margins + continuous small-batch inference load to exercise KV cache paths. If it only fails under specific seq lengths that'd be interesting.

jamie: Action items:
- sam: run gpuburn+stress and attach logs to INF-3245 (started)
- maria: arrange slot swap tomorrow morning (ETA 09:30 PT)
- neha: update soak profile to include fan oscillation and PCIe AER scraping (in progress)
- lucas: add AER watcher and alert if Xid > 1 in 5m window

sam: starting gpuburn now. Will post short log snippet on failure.

ops-bot: soak job j-2297 status: running (1h elapsed).

jamie: If we get >3 soft XIDs in 24h we'll RMA the card. If only single transient events and other cards in rack clean -> re-run 48h soak and then bring back.

neha: noted. I'll also check historical telemetry for g2-21 (thermal cycles, power spikes) and link findings to INF-3245.

maria: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
